text: Pilot reps made 14% more calls per week than the control group
quote: Treatment reps logged 14% more HCP calls per week than matched controls over weeks 3 to 8.

text: Reps report saving 3-4 hours a week on call notes and preparation
quote: Notes and call prep used to take most of my Friday afternoon. Now it is done before I leave the car.

text: Conversion on visits suggested by next-best-action was 5% above control
quote: Visits suggested by next-best-action converted 5% better than comparable visits without a suggestion.
Reported conversion uplift ranged from 3% to 8% across the six programmes reviewed.

text: Content open rates rose, but the follow-up effect was not significant after 6 weeks
quote: Open rates on personalised content rose, but follow-up requests were flat after six weeks.

text: Review time per item fell from 9 to 4 hours
quote: Median review time per generated item fell from nine hours to four.

text: Two markets have more than 30% of HCP records incomplete
quote: In two markets, more than 30% of HCP master records lack specialty or territory fields.

text: 78% of pilot reps used the agent daily by week 4
quote: By week four, 78% of pilot reps opened the agent on every working day.

text: Adoption typically drops 15-20 points after a pilot without incentives
quote: Once the pilot attention fades, daily use usually drops 15 to 20 points unless someone keeps chasing it.

text: Zero compliance incidents across 2,900 generated call notes
quote: No off-label or compliance incident was raised across 2,900 generated call notes.

text: Works council requires an opt-out from individual usage reporting
quote: We will not accept individual usage reporting without an opt-out for each employee.

text: Comparable rollouts took 12-20 months across 6-10 markets
quote: Programmes covering six to ten markets took between 12 and 20 months to reach full rollout.

text: Industry estimates of payback range widely, from 1 to 4 years
quote: Published payback estimates for commercial AI range from one to four years.

text: Pilot unit economics imply payback within 18 months at 80% adoption
quote: At 80% adoption, pilot unit economics pay back the rollout cost within 18 months.
